headline: Nifty Gains Amid Metal Rally While Sensex Slips On IT Drags
why: Higher US Treasury yields weighing on global investor sentiment
Strong performance in smallcap and metal sectors boosting Nifty
Anticipation of Federal Reserve interest rate decisions affecting IT stocks
Investor caution following AAII survey showing 16-month low sentiment
whatHappening: Sensex closed marginally lower by 22 points while Nifty gained 53
Smallcap stocks jumped nearly 1.8 percent outperforming the broader market
Toyota plans 6.4 billion dollar annual automation spend from 2028
SBI projects 5 trillion rupee notional profit for banks from FCNR(B)

stocksInNews.sources: Sensex slips into red after CAS
IT drags while metals and FMCG shine
FCNR(B) may generate 5 trillion profit for banks
IT drags ahead of Fed call
FCNR(B) notional profit for banks over 5 years
SBI report on FCNR(B) bank profit projections
FMCG shine ahead of Fed call
Toyota sees 6.4 billion annual automation spend

summary:
The Indian market showed mixed results with Nifty gaining on metal and FMCG strength.
IT stocks dragged the Sensex down amid rising US Treasury yields and Fed rate hike fears.
Banking sectors remain optimistic following SBI's report on FCNR(B) profit potential for banks.
